Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro.en: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?
Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro.fr: Tu veux savoir si ça mord ?

Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle.en: I can't catch anything good.\nNot one good POKéMON to be had!
Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle.fr: Je n'attrape rien de bien.\nPas un seul bon POKéMON !

Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro.en: The sea cleanses my body and soul!
Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro.fr: La mer purifie mon corps et mon\nâme !

Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle.en: The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.
Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle.fr: La mer, c'est super, mais j'aime\naussi les montagnes.

Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat.en: Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make\nthe grade, do they?
Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat.fr: Héhéhé, les MAGICARPE ne font pas\nle poids, hein ?

Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro.en: I got a big haul!\nWanna go for it?
Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro.fr: J'ai fait une belle prise !\nTu veux tenter ta chance ?

Route21_North_Text_WadePostBattle.en: I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!
